Innovation Industries, Inc. is a privately held US manufacturer headquartered at 3500 East Main Street, Russellville, Arkansas 72802. Founded in 1972, the company specialises in elevator fixtures, push buttons, controls, and accessories. It operates manufacturing facilities in Arkansas and through subsidiaries Virginia Controls, Inc. (VCI) in Virginia and Monitor Elevator Products (MEP). Additional entities include Innovation Aviation (corporate aviation) and 125 Ricefield (real estate holding). The company employs approximately 200-335 people and generates an estimated ~$100M in annual revenue, serving major elevator companies including Otis, KONE, and ThyssenKrupp. Paul Horney IV serves as President & CEO.

The exfiltrated dataset totals approximately 257 GB spanning 15 top-level directory trees from Windows file server network shares, capturing the company's entire digital footprint from 1997 through September 2026. The canonical filetree contains 751,853 entries.

<redacted>

Employee PII and HR Data. The HR share (3.6 GB) contains W-2 tax forms for all Innovation Industries, Virginia Controls, and Monitor Elevator employees from 2020 through 2025, exposing Social Security Numbers and wages for an estimated 300-500 individuals. Additional records include individual tax returns, I-9 immigration forms with citizenship status, benefits enrollment forms (BSI and CAS series) with SSN, date of birth, and dependent information, health insurance records, prescription cards, workers compensation injury data, 401(k) retirement records, personnel files, performance evaluations, disciplinary records, and at least one passport scan. Employee records span named individuals across 28+ VCI employee files and 34+ scanned personnel records.

Financial and MNPI. The dataset contains the company's complete financial history: audited financial statements from 1997 through 2018; monthly balance sheets and P&L statements from January 2017 through February 2024 for Innovation Industries, Innovation Aviation, and 125 Ricefield; board meeting packages with notes from 2012 through August 2026 (current year); subsidiary valuations including VCI working capital and valuation analysis; CARES Act PPP loan documents; 20+ years of accounts payable records (46 GB across 180-550+ vendor folders per year); bank reconciliation files for 8 separate bank accounts; and payroll budget worksheets. Vendor 1099 databases (2016-2020) contain Tax ID numbers for 250-1,000 vendors across all 50 states.

Manufacturing Intellectual Property. The dataset contains 27 GB of CNC machining programs encoding the complete manufacturing process for 2,400+ elevator fixture parts — representing 50+ years of accumulated manufacturing know-how. Additionally: 16 GB of engineering drawings, 1.7 GB of Haas CNC programs, 561 MB of laser cutting programs, RADAN sheet metal nesting data, and SolidWorks 3D design files. This material collectively enables a competitor to replicate Innovation Industries' entire product line.

Legal and Privileged Material. The Photo Eye product liability lawsuit directory contains insurance claim files, claim numbers, insurer correspondence, and lawsuit-related documents. Board meeting notes may contain privileged legal discussions. These files create privilege waiver risk under FRE 502(b).

IT and Infrastructure. Active Directory user exports (108 accounts), DHCP network topology, Postman API environment files revealing internal network endpoints (10.0.1.184:3001), and comprehensive server/backup documentation provide a complete map of the company's IT infrastructure.
